title: Sub Inspector (Civil Police), Sub Inspector (Intelligence), Platoon Commander, Fire Station Second Officer and Excise Sub Inspector
qualification: For Sub Inspector (Civil Police), Sub Inspector (Intelligence), Platoon Commander and Fire Station Second Officer posts, the notification provides an Intermediate or equivalent educational qualification provision for eligible ex-servicemen. || Candidates claiming eligibility under this provision must satisfy the applicable ex-servicemen conditions prescribed in the recruitment advertisement.
salary: Selected candidates for Sub Inspector (Civil Police), Sub Inspector (Intelligence), Platoon Commander and Fire Station Second Officer posts will receive a Level 7 pay scale of Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400. Excise Sub Inspectors will receive a Level 5 pay scale of Rs. 29,200 to Rs. 92,300. || The advertised pay scales represent basic pay under the respective pay levels. Actual monthly remuneration will depend on applicable allowances, deductions and Government service rules.
age_limit: Candidates applying for Police Sub Inspector, Platoon Commander and Fire Station Second Officer posts must be between 21 and 35 years of age. The age limit for Excise Sub Inspector posts is 21 to 42 years. Age will be calculated as of 1 July 2026.
application_fee: Candidates must pay the examination fee online using the payment facilities provided through the official application portal. || Debit Card || Credit Card || Net Banking || UPI || The application will be treated as complete only after successful submission and confirmation of the applicable examination fee payment.
selection_process: UKSSSC will conduct the recruitment in two principal competitive stages. The first stage consists of physical standards and physical efficiency examinations, while the second stage consists of a 200-mark objective written examination for candidates who qualify in the physical tests. || Physical Standards Test (PST):Candidates must satisfy the prescribed physical measurement requirements applicable to their selected posts. || Physical Efficiency Test (PET):Candidates must qualify in the prescribed physical activities. || Written Examination:Candidates who qualify in the physical examinations will be eligible to appear for the objective competitive written examination. || Document Verification:Educational qualifications, age, reservation claims and other eligibility documents will be verified. || Medical Examination:Candidates must satisfy the prescribed medical and physical fitness requirements before appointment. || The final merit list will be prepared on the basis of performance in the written examination, subject to the applicable eligibility, reservation and appointment conditions.
syllabus: Detailed Syllabus To be published separately by UKSSSC

selection_process: The selection process comprises three consecutive stages: || Preliminary Examination:Objective-type screening test consisting of General Studies and General Aptitude Test. || Main Examination:Written descriptive-type examination comprising four papers. || Personality Test (Interview):Viva-voce test for candidates provisionally successful in the main written examination.
